name: ProbeLeader Co., Ltd.
summary: Founded in 2002, ProbeLeader Co., Ltd. is dedicated to engineering and manufacturing sophisticated testing solutions for a variety of high-tech industries. These include the semiconductor, LCD panel, optoelectronics, and passive components sectors. The company's extensive product offerings encompass essential components like probe cards, load boards, and test sockets, alongside a selection of specialized equipment and tools. ProbeLeader maintains its corporate headquarters in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.
